scenario: A FOIA (Freedom of Information Act) officer processes a public-records request by first redacting exempt information from the responsive government document, then logging the redaction decisions to an immutable compliance audit trail, and finally generating a formatted FOIA response package for release to the requester.
info_flow: redacta processes the raw government document and produces a redacted version with a redaction report → compliance-audit logs the exemption decisions and produces a release-authorization summary → reporting assembles the final FOIA response package incorporating the redacted document text and release authorization.
